newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 14.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 14.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Prime Minister Gyula Horn's Luxembourg visit can be considered the first preliminary round of talks on the country's European Union accesion.
- Opposition Christian Democrat Party was ousted of the international Christian-Democrat Union.
- Finance Minister Peter Medgyessy said the unions' demand for a five percent real wage increase next year is unacceptable.
- Those who do not attend a dentistry screening by the end of the year could lose their right to free treatment.
- The Hague court has sentenced Bosnian Serb Dusko Tadic to twenty years in prison for crimes against humanity.
- Bela Marko, head of the Democratic Alliance of Hungarians in Romania warned those with minority opinions within the party to obey majority decisions.
